verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local LLM inference engine, so x86 SIMD/matrix acceleration (AVX, AVX2, AVX512, AMX) is a fair question for it. The evidence never mentions any of these instruction sets. The documented backends are MLX on iOS, a native Kotlin engine on Android, C++ + Vulkan on Windows, Rust on macOS, and a reserved CUDA slot, with no x86 CPU-specific optimization path.
